Empty exclude_selectors list does not affect output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Hello world</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: []))
puts result.content.inspect
```
